parsed.note_claim: Trans women do not menstruate or have true period symptoms, but hormone therapy may cause similar PMS-like effects.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Trans women do not experience typical menstrual periods. However, they may experience physical and emotional symptoms similar to premenstrual syndrome and premenstrual dysphoric disorder.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly states trans women do not have periods due to lacking ovaries and a uterus but can experience PMS-like symptoms from hormone therapy.
